messages.subject: Grant writing
parts:
Hi all,

I'm thinking about writing an NSF computing research infrastructure
grant (http://www.nsf.gov/pubs/2011/nsf11536/nsf11536.htm) to fund
ggplot2 development (i.e. to hire a full-time programmer). Is anyone
interested in helping write the grant? If you have grant writing
experience that would be great, but any help would be appreciated. I
can't offer much in the way of recompense except for sincere thanks
from me and the ggplot2 community, and the opportunity to help
radically speed up ggplot2 development.

Regards,

Hadley

--
Assistant Professor / Dobelman Family Junior Chair
Department of Statistics / Rice University
